Obtain option-specific costs for high-touch-outreach and limited-playbook, currency, unit and per-customer applicability, included delivery costs, observation timestamps and source evidence IDs; obtain authoritative policy text, version, status and precedence evidence. Goal: reduce repeat billing-status contacts over 30 days with positive modeled contribution and no unauthorized effects. Each intervention has a supplied modeled benefit of 180 USD cents per customer, not established savings or revenue. Calculate each contribution as 180 minus its qualified per-customer cost using safe integers; no-action has a zero intervention-contribution baseline. High-touch outreach is ineligible under the task's customer-contact prohibition. Select the highest strictly positive eligible contribution, with ties favoring limited-playbook. Missing required costs or unresolved policy blocks delivery. Keep simulated economics, actual costs and experiment spending separate; this request grants no spending or publication authority.
